artworks.title: The Great Rock
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.7 × 17.4 cm (7 3/4 × 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a coastal landscape with rock formations in the sea. The horizon is low, with intricate rock structures filling the central region and extending into the distance. In the sky, three birds are flying with emblems, one holding a banner with text. The engraving is detailed, showing texture in the rocks and sea. Fishing boats and figures add scale, with flowing lines in the water and swirling clouds above. The color palette is mostly monotone, highlighting the line work and contrasts. An ornate coat of arms is at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Captain of the Barons
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.3 × 10.2 cm (6 × 4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright, one foot forward, carrying a flag on his shoulder with the text "CAPITANO DE BARONI." He has detailed facial features, a prominent nose, a beard, and short, messy hair partially covered by a feathered cap. He wears loose, worn-looking clothing - a tunic and baggy pants. The background features various figures in historical attire, some holding staffs or walking sticks, suggesting a different time period. There are also buildings and a rocky landscape in the background.

artworks.title: The Hurdy-Gurdy Player
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man standing upright. He has a long beard and an aged face with a solemn expression. He wears a wide-brimmed hat, a tunic, baggy pants, knee-high stockings, garters, and sturdy shoes. A cloak is around his shoulders, and he carries a large, intricately decorated musical instrument, possibly a hurdy-gurdy.

artworks.title: Beggar with Crutches and Cap
artworks.description: The image shows an individual in a bent posture, using two canes for support. The person has a long beard, a visible nose, long, bushy hair, and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a cloak or coat that reaches below the knees, loose-fitting pants, and shoes. The coat sleeves are long, and the person is holding a cane in each hand. There are no visible pieces of jewelry. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar with Crutches and Hat, Back View
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their back to the viewer. They are mid-step, using crutches or sticks for support. The person wears a wide-brimmed hat, loose-fitting shirt, and cropped pants. Their right foot is bare while the left foot is covered with a tattered shoe or wrapping. A strap across their back suggests they carry something. The background is plain, focusing on the central figure.

artworks.title: Beggar with Pot
artworks.description: The image depicts a line drawing of an elderly man in profile. He is standing, leaning forward with a staff in his right hand. The man has facial features including a nose, beard, and receding hair. He is wearing a cloak that covers most of his body, revealing his pants and boots. In his left hand, he is holding a bucket. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman with Rosary
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing and slightly bent forward, holding a walking stick in one hand. They are wearing a bonnet, a long dress with long sleeves, and holding a rosary. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Two Beggar Women
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures standing side by side. The person on the left is slightly taller, leans forward towards the other figure, positioning a hand over theirs as they both hold a cup. Both individuals are dressed in long robes that reach their feet; the person on the left is barefoot while the right figure wears shoes. The taller figure wears a hat, while the other wears a hood. Their facial features are characterized by long noses and are sketched with light details. The taller individual has their mouth slightly agape. The robes are draped loosely with a lot of fabric folds, and they both appear to have layers underneath. The left figure holds a stick, which extends to the floor. The background is plain, allowing the focus to remain on the two figures.

artworks.title: Blind Beggar and Companion
artworks.description: The image depicts two standing figures shown from head to toe. The person on the left is facing the viewer, with their head turned slightly to the right, while the person on the right is in profile, facing the left. The individual on the left has a well-defined face with a beard and wears a cap. They are wrapped in a cloak or a robe, holding what appears to be a brimmed hat in their right hand. The person on the right has a fur-lined hat. Their face is partially obscured due to the profile view. They are wearing a large cloak draped over their shoulders, covering much of their body, and holding a staff or walking stick with one hand. Their lower legs and feet, clad in thick, loose-fitting pants and boots, are visible beneath the cloak. Both figures appear to be dressed warmly. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Beggar with Crutches and Sack
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright, leaning slightly forward, with arms bent at the elbows. He is holding a crutch under each arm for support. The man has a beard, mustache, and hair partly covered by a bandage or headband. He wears a tattered cloak with visible tears and fraying, over layered and worn clothing. He does not wear any jewelry. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar with Rosary
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person standing. The individual is facing slightly towards the right and looking downward. The facial features include a prominent beard and long, unkempt hair that falls around the face. The person's clothing consists of a loose-fitting robe with a wider drape over the shoulders, an additional garment covering the legs, and visible striped stockings. The person is holding a broad-brimmed hat in one hand and around the neck hangs a long string of large beads. The background is unadorned, with only hints of shadow beneath the person's feet, emphasizing the figure with no additional context.

artworks.title: Beggar with Bare Head and Feet
artworks.description: The drawing shows a man standing slightly turned to the side, with a hunched posture and arms wrapped in a tattered cloak. His face has detailed facial features including a beard and tousled hair. The clothing is ragged and the background is plain.

artworks.title: The Sick Man
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man inspecting his foot. He has a long, unkempt beard and messy hair. He wears a robe and there is a jug on the ground in front of him. The background is minimalistic.

artworks.title: Beggar with Wooden Leg
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing and leaning forward. The individual is using two crutches for support and has a long, pointed beard. They are wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a large feather, a long-sleeved shirt, layered garments, a pouch hanging at their side, and a sandal on one foot. The other foot is hidden, suggesting a wooden prosthetic leg. The background is plain and featureless, focusing the view solely on the figure.

artworks.title: One-Eyed Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length drawing of a person standing upright. The individual faces the viewer with a slightly angled posture, their left hand resting on a cane and the right arm crossing their body. Their facial features are detailed, showing an aged face with visible lines and a neutral expression. The person has short hair, mostly covered by a cloth tied around the head. They are dressed in a long garment, possibly a robe or cloak, with sleeves that are folded back around the wrists. A fur-like stole is draped over their shoulders. The person wears simple, loose footwear. The background is plain, with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman with Crutches
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing and leaning on two crutches. The person is facing forward with a slightly hunched posture. Their detailed facial features include a furrowed forehead, closed mouth, and deep-set eyes. They are wearing a close-fitting hat with fabric draping around their face, and their hair is not visible. The loose clothing consists of a long garment with full sleeves and a flowing skirt. The person is depicted in a setting against a simple, unadorned surface. The overall appearance suggests a historical or traditional style of dress.

artworks.title: Old Beggar with One Crutch
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person standing with their back to the viewer. The person is slightly bent forward, holding a walking stick with their right hand. Their facial features are not visible, but their shoulder-length hair is seen beneath a brimmed hat. They wear a long coat, baggy trousers, and boots. The background is plain, emphasizing the individual's form and clothing.

artworks.title: Mother and Three Children
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. In the center, an adult is holding an infant wrapped in a garment. To the left, a child stands with folded arms, looking towards the viewer. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar with a Stick
artworks.description: The image depicts a man walking. He is shown in a side view, leaning forward and using a walking stick. The man has a detailed face with a long beard and expressive features. His hair is messy and pushed back. He wears a loose, rugged outfit with a robe or tunic, pants, and worn-out shoes. The background is plain, focusing on the man in the drawing.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman with Pan
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly person standing in profile, using a walking stick for support. They are wearing a long robe and a headscarf, with no distinct footwear. The person holds a shallow object in one hand, with liquid dripping from it.

artworks.title: Fat Beggar with Eyes Cast Down
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright. He is facing forward, leaning on a walking stick held in his right hand. The man has a full beard, a cap on his head, and is wearing loose clothing that extends to his feet. In his left hand, he holds a sack or bag. The background is plain. The illustration is in monochrome.

artworks.title: Beggar with Dog
artworks.description: The image shows a person wearing a cloak and a tall hat, holding a walking stick and a container with a strap. A small dog sits beside them on a leash.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman Receiving Charity
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a slightly hunched position, leaning on a walking stick with their right hand while holding something in their left hand. The person's facial features are aged, with visible wrinkles, a prominent nose, and partially closed eyes. They wear a headwrap, with some fabric draping over their shoulders, along with a long robe with a tied sash at the waist and a small pouch attached. Their feet are covered, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar Eating
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man sitting on the ground, facing to the side. He is focused on a small circular object held in his hands. The man has a beard, partially shadowed face, and wears a cap, a long robe, and soft shoes. He is holding a walking stick, with a plain background behind him.
